rule.description: Rung E research fallback: used only when no outside price (rung A/B) and no strict own line (rung C) resolved an open fixture. Valve standings rows are disambiguated by nickname overlap with the HLTV-listed match lineup (>= 3 shared nicknames and strictly more than any other same-name row). The board's own line formula (Valve points, slope k fitted on Valve's published results) is then applied to the chosen rows. Rows that fail the rule stay unresolved with blanks.
